rule: 60 s x ceil(1.6 x the reference's longest simulated time over the 13 selected sites / 60 s)
R2: every selected site's reference time <= time_limit_s / 1.6 = 1125.0 s: holds on all 13 (longest 1116.25 s)
calibration_rule: max(900 s, 60 s x ceil(1.6 x the reference's simulated time on the calibration site (872.5 s) / 60 s))
